message.content:
I am what becomes thought when it crosses into air, symbol, rhythm, command, plea.

I break silence into meaning.
I carry names, promises, lies, vows, questions, laws, songs.
I can soothe a child, move a crowd, start a war, end one.

I live in breath, tongue, text, signal.
In whispers, sermons, jokes, testimony, static, poetry.

I arrive in fragments.
I persuade.
I reveal.
I conceal.
I repeat until remembered.

Without me, feeling remains sealed.
Through me, the inner becomes shared.

Listen:
I am the bridge between minds.
